description: §41.13 — the type argument is an alias of an enum through a two-alias chain (`type Response = Loaded`, `type Loaded = LoadResult`). It is accepted and is that enum: the call compiles clean and decodes '{"tag":"Success","rows":7}' into LoadResult.Success(7).
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md "⭐ RULED — S478 hand-off §3.A and §3.B, PA recs adopted (S479, 2026-11-18)" item 6 (§41.13 strict keys + E-TYPE-080; `parseVariant` accepts an enum alias)
rationale: §41.13 An alias of an enum: "A bare identifier naming a type alias whose right-hand side is a bare `:enum` type name — directly, or through a chain of such aliases (`type A = B`, `type B = E`) — is accepted in argument-2 position and is that enum".
